sentences.text:
Mr. B.N. Samantray, Advocate
 -versus-
 Suresh Kumar
 Upadhyaya & another

.... Respondents
 Mr. G.P. Dutta, Advocate
 (O.P.2)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order

In course of hearing, Mr. Dutta, learned counsel for the Insurance Company, places reliance on the judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Rajkumar Agarwal vrs. Vehicle Tata Venture, Commercial Auto Sales Private Ltd., through its Director and others, 2023 (2) T.A.C 28 (S.C) wherein the matter has been referred to the larger Bench to decide the issue as to whether in the event one who is covered by the scheme under the ESI Act can claim compensation in terms of the Motor Vehicles Act.

entities.text: Rajkumar Agarwal vrs. Vehicle Tata Venture, Commercial Auto Sales Private Ltd.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the referral order the Apex Court has taken note of the conflicting views.
2. It is stated at the Bar that the larger Bench is yet to answer the reference.

3. In view of the same and since the issue involved in the present MACA is substantially akin to the issue referred to the larger Bench of the Apex Court, list this matter on 11.07.2025.
4.
Liberty is given to the parties to make a mention before the roster Bench in the event reference is answered earlier by the Apex Court, to the date of the next listing.

(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Signed by: PRADEEP KUMAR SWAIN Location: Orissa High Court,
